visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up shot of a smartphone screen displaying a shopping app. A hand scrolls through a product page for a Shiba Inu-themed AirPods case priced at NT$99. The background consists of a person's lap and a light-colored floor. (2) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a grey off-the-shoulder top, is sitting on a brown leather sofa. She initially looks at her phone and then looks up to speak directly into the camera with an expressive face. Behind her is a black wall decorated with small yellow flower drawings and a pillow with a dog's face. (3) The camera cuts to the woman standing in an office, holding a long tan plush microphone. She is interviewing a person wearing a green Shrek mask and a bright green hoodie sitting in a black office chair. Computers, monitors, and office desk clutter are visible in the background under bright indoor lighting. (4) The host interviews a young man sitting at his desk wearing a black and white striped shirt under a dark denim jacket. He holds a purple headphone case while gesturing towards the computer screen. (5) A young woman with long dark hair is seen sitting at a cluttered desk with a silver laptop, looking at the camera and talking. She holds a white headphone case. (6) The host interviews another woman with short hair wearing a beige jacket in the office hallway, followed by a man in a black sweater and a black baseball cap who shows off a white earbud case. The camera movements are handheld and dynamic with frequent jump cuts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice begins speaking rapidly over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat. A bright 'ding' SFX marks the visual transition from the phone screen to the host. (2) The audio shifts to a conversational multi-speaker format as the host interviews colleagues. Each visual jump cut is accompanied by a subtle 'pop' or 'whoosh' sound effect. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume in the background. (3) A male voice with a calm, neutral tone describes his headphones, followed by a playful 'boing' cartoon SFX when he makes a joke about the price. Ambient office noise is extremely low, and the primary focus remains on the clear speech and the rhythmic music. (4) The interview cycle continues with various speakers; female voices appear with varying pitch heights, and another male voice speaks with high arousal and laughter. The BGM swells slightly in volume toward the end with synthesized textures.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Street Interview -> Comparison -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an entertaining social experiment and tech commentary where the host finds an incredibly cheap pair of headphones online and polls her colleagues to see what they currently use and if they would trust such a low-priced product. It aims to highlight the contrast between premium brand value and budget clones.
